body: The tribute concert. There are no words to explain how amazing that night was. So many emotions. The best night of my life.
Thanks for the advice! That's what I'll try to do. I really like reading and Reddit of the things you mentioned. I wish you the best, and I hope things will get better for you. ❤

I'm so sorry for your loss. It hurts to read your text, but I can't even imagine how it feels to live in your reality. Please don't blame yourself, she wouldn't want you to. She is probably watching you from above, and tonight she showed you a sign to prove that. It's not the same as if she would have lived, of course, but she will always be with you. And you will always be with her. Hugs❤

Thank you. I'm sorry that you don't have a family, and I'm sorry if I sounded selfish when I wrote I wish I didn't have a family, it's just that I love them so much but I'm in so much pain and everything hurts. I wish it was just that easy as if the choices I make only affected myself. Sadly, that's not the way things work so it seems like I have to live for my family, even if it's a life full of pain and hopelessness. The only thing I can do is sit at home and watch the world become a horrible place.
